segments.segment_summary: A montage of a successful ice fishing trip, showing the equipment, a fisherman with a large trout, a pile of caught fish on the snow, and an underwater view of a trout.

key_moments.caption: Shot of ice fishing gear laid out on the snow.
A man proudly holds up a large trout next to an ice fishing shelter.
An overhead shot shows several caught trout lying in the snow.
Underwater footage shows a trout swimming near the surface under the ice.

segments.segment_summary: A dramatic montage with underwater and above-water shots capturing the moment a large trout is caught, pulled through a hole in the ice, and unhooked.

key_moments.caption: Underwater view of a large trout being reeled towards a hole in the ice.
A man's hand reaches into the water inside a shelter to unhook the trout.
The man releases the trout back into the water through the ice hole.
Another underwater sequence shows a trout biting a lure and fighting as it's pulled towards the ice hole.

segments.segment_summary: Several fishermen pose for the camera with their large trout and a burbot they've caught while ice fishing on a sunny day.

key_moments.caption: A smiling man in a red hoodie holds up a large trout in the snowy landscape.
Another man in overalls smiles while holding his catch in front of an ice fishing shelter.
The man shows off his catch to another person inside the shelter.
A close-up shot of a burbot lying on the snow.

segments.segment_summary: A montage of catching another trout, including an underwater view of it being pulled through the ice hole by hand, brought inside a shelter, and having the hook removed from its mouth.

key_moments.caption: An overhead shot shows a burbot and two trout lying on the snow next to an ice auger.
Underwater footage shows a man's hand reaching through the ice hole to grab a hooked trout.
The caught trout is seen thrashing on the wet floor of the ice fishing shelter.
Inside the shelter, one man holds the trout while another uses pliers to remove the hook from its mouth.
